Metadata.Name: Access Request Approval
Metadata.Description: Standard two-stage approval for user access requests to internal systems.

Activity.Name: Line Manager Approval
Activity.Description: Direct manager approves the access request on behalf of the employee.

Activity.Name: Security Team Sign-off
Activity.Description: Security team validates the request against least-privilege policy.

Activity.Name: Provision Access
Activity.Description: IAM operations team provisions the approved access in the target system.
